description: Defines core type system classes and utilities for PyTorch's JIT type representation, including Type hierarchy, singleton types, shared types, and type casting mechanisms.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a type in PyTorch's JIT type system, supporting subtyping, casting, and type annotations.

classes.name: SharedType
classes.description: Derived from Type, guarantees ownership via std::shared_ptr, used for singleton and shared types.

classes.name: NamedType
classes.description: Derived from SharedType, represents named types with optional qualified names, such as classes or enums.

methods.name: withContained
methods.description: Creates a new type with replaced contained types.

methods.name: createWithContained
methods.description: Constructs a type with specified contained types; to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: isSubtypeOfExt
methods.description: Checks subtype relation with additional details.

methods.name: annotation_str
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the type for annotations, with optional custom printer.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the type for schema declarations.

methods.name: repr_str
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string with additional info.
